scope: Project-authored MSVC SDL expression and project source-list compatibility adaptations; no upstream approval claimed; unsigned size_t alignment arithmetic unchanged

alignment_patch.reason: Native MSVC14.51 /sdl C4146 at FFI_ALIGN_DOWN; dest and alignment are size_t, so ~(alignment-1) equals -alignment modulo unsigned width. No SDL or warning checks disabled.

msvc_project_patch.reason: Official Makefile.am includes src/tramp.c; supplied MSVC project omits it, causing four native ffi_tramp unresolved symbols. Add the same official source, preserving build flags; normalize project line endings for reproducible patching.

cffi_consumer.scope: Project-authored native ARM64-only static source selection and local identity, plus minimal guarded selection of existing ffi_prep_cif_var for the Microsoft variadic ABI. Windows closure allocation is unchanged. No upstream approval, preview parent, controlled runtime/crypto/producer adoption or unchanged official distribution claim.
cffi_consumer.static_linkage: libffi3.8 ffi.h.in uses FFI_STATIC_BUILD; cffi old FFI_BUILDING alone produces16 __imp_ffi link errors in run42764087999. Enable the upstream static declaration macro in the opt-in ARM64 configuration; no C implementation change.

variadic_compatibility.source_api: libffi3.8.0 src/prep_cif.c, src/aarch64/ffi.c and cffi2.1.1 existing fb_prepare_cif variadic branch
variadic_compatibility.minimum_change: Enable the existing ffi_prep_cif_var path only for the controlled Windows ARM64 build; preserve closure flags and actual mixed floating/integer/string regression.
